protocol.task_selection: First five source-hash-ranked tasks in the frozen SWE32+Terminal32 population with one complete unchanged published request in each declared band; first eligible source-order request per band. No score, speed, answer, cropping or padding filter.
protocol.tenant_identity: Four independent closed-loop client queues; OpenAI user field tenant-0..3 and unique per-request cache salts. Shared engine/resources; no security-isolation or dedicated-VM claim.
protocol.acceptance: Preserve the original qualitative throughput/tail stability and high utilization criteria; no invented pass threshold. Complete execution produces measurements, not an automatic numerical pass.
protocol.source_tasks_are_not_concurrency: Five distinct real histories; eight closed-loop lanes cycle the fixed cases, repetitions are not independent task samples.

utilization.method: Sampler clock midpoint; request interval clipped; left-hold, time weighted. A sample estimate, not continuous hardware truth.
